tasks.title: Add a customer
tasks.statement: Add a customer: id 13, `'Oleg Zhukov'`, city `'Omsk'`, email `'oleg@mail.ru'`, registration date `'2024-07-15'`, vip 0 (INSERT INTO customers VALUES …).
tasks.hint: Values go in the order of the table's columns.

tasks.title: Column list
tasks.statement: Add a customer, listing the columns: name, city, registered (the id will be assigned automatically, vip defaults to 0, email is NULL). Values: `'Oleg Zhukov'`, `'Omsk'`, `'2024-07-15'`.
tasks.hint: INSERT INTO customers (name, city, registered) VALUES (...)

tasks.title: Default value
tasks.statement: Add the customer `'Petr Yakovlev'` (city `'Tver'`, registered `'2024-07-20'`) without specifying vip — DEFAULT 0 will apply.

tasks.title: NULL on insert
tasks.statement: Add the customer `'Rita Kim'` with the date `'2024-07-21'`; do not specify the city and email (NULL).

tasks.title: Several rows
tasks.statement: Add two customers with one command: `'Sergey Tikhonov'` (`'Kazan'`, `'2024-07-22'`) and `'Taisia Gromova'` (`'Moscow'`, `'2024-07-23'`). Columns: name, city, registered.
tasks.hint: After VALUES, several parenthesized groups separated by commas.

tasks.title: New product
tasks.statement: Add a product: id 14, `'Webcam'`, category `'Accessories'`, price 2800, stock 15, brand `'Sonic'`.

tasks.title: Order and items
tasks.statement: Place order id 21 for customer 7 on the date `'2024-08-01'`, status `'new'` (total is 0 for now), with two items: product 4 — 2 pcs at 1500 and product 8 — 1 pc at 420.

tasks.title: Recalculate the total
tasks.statement: Continuation: the total of order 21 must be calculated. Add the order and items (as in the previous task) and then UPDATE orders SET total = (sum of qty * price over the order's items) WHERE id = 21.

tasks.title: INSERT ... SELECT
tasks.statement: Copy the VIP customers (vip = 1) into the table vip_customers(id, name, city): INSERT INTO vip_customers SELECT id, name, city FROM customers WHERE vip = 1.
tasks.hint: The empty table vip_customers has already been created.

tasks.title: Order archive
tasks.statement: Move the cancelled orders into the table orders_archive (the same columns id, customer_id, created, status, total) and delete them from orders.

tasks.title: OR IGNORE
tasks.statement: Inserting a customer with an existing id ends with an error. INSERT OR IGNORE silently skips such a row. Add with OR IGNORE: `(1, 'Duplicate', ...)` and `(14, 'New', ...)`. Columns id, name, registered.

tasks.title: OR REPLACE
tasks.statement: INSERT OR REPLACE replaces the row on a key match. Replace the customer with id 3 by `('Vera Smirnova-Kim', 'Moscow', 'vera@mail.ru', '2024-02-20', 1)`; specify all the columns.

tasks.title: UPSERT
tasks.statement: Table notes. Add the note id 2 with the text `'call Anna and Boris'`; if the id already exists, update body (INSERT … ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET body = excluded.body).
tasks.hint: excluded — the values from the failed insert.

tasks.title: A single UPDATE
tasks.statement: Change the city of the customer with id 2 to `'Saint Petersburg'`.
tasks.hint: Without WHERE all rows will change!

tasks.title: Two columns
tasks.statement: For customer 9, set the city `'Novosibirsk'` and the email `'ksenia@mail.ru'`.

tasks.title: Many rows
tasks.statement: Raise the prices of books (category = `'Books'`) by 10%: price = price * 11 / 10.

tasks.title: Discount
tasks.statement: Reduce by 100 rubles the price of products that cost more than 1000.

tasks.title: Restock
tasks.statement: Raise the stock of all products with zero stock to 20.

tasks.title: Clear a field
tasks.statement: Erase the email of customer 3 (set NULL if needed) and of customer 1: email = NULL for id IN (1, 3).

tasks.title: UPDATE without WHERE
tasks.statement: Set the total of all orders to 0 (an UPDATE without WHERE changes the whole table).

tasks.title: UPDATE with CASE
tasks.statement: Raise the price of `'Tech'` products by 5%, `'Books'` by 10%, and leave the rest unchanged — with one UPDATE using CASE: price = CASE category WHEN … THEN … ELSE price END.

tasks.title: Recalculating totals
tasks.statement: The order totals in the orders table have been zeroed (total = 0). Compute the total of each order again from its items: UPDATE orders SET total = (SELECT SUM(qty * price) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = orders.id).

tasks.title: VIP for a big order
tasks.statement: Make VIP (vip = 1) all customers who have an order with a total over 40000 (EXISTS or IN).

tasks.title: UPDATE ... FROM
tasks.statement: The table deliveries(product_id, qty) holds deliveries. Increase the products' stock by the delivered quantity: UPDATE products SET stock = stock + d.qty FROM deliveries d WHERE d.product_id = products.id.

tasks.title: Write off stock
tasks.statement: After sales, decrease stock by the sold quantity for product 4: stock = stock − (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM order_items WHERE product_id = 4) WHERE id = 4.

tasks.title: Swapping values
tasks.statement: In the table pairs(id, a, b) swap a and b in each row: UPDATE pairs SET a = b, b = a (the right-hand side uses the old values).

tasks.title: DELETE one row
tasks.statement: Delete the customer with id 12.
tasks.hint: Without WHERE all rows are deleted.

tasks.title: DELETE by condition
tasks.statement: Delete the completed notes (done = 1) from notes.

tasks.title: Empty a table
tasks.statement: Delete all rows from notes.

tasks.title: Delete dependents
tasks.statement: Delete the items of cancelled orders, and then the cancelled orders themselves (status = `'cancelled'`). First order_items.
tasks.hint: Child rows first, then parent rows.

tasks.title: Delete inactive
tasks.statement: Delete the customers who have no orders at all (NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)).

tasks.title: Delete the earliest
tasks.statement: Delete the customer with the earliest registration date (id = (SELECT id … ORDER BY registered LIMIT 1)).

tasks.title: INSERT RETURNING
tasks.statement: Add a customer (`'Oleg Zhukov'`, `'Omsk'`, registered `'2024-07-15'`) and return the assigned id and name: INSERT … RETURNING id, name.
tasks.hint: RETURNING outputs the rows the command changed.

tasks.title: UPDATE RETURNING
tasks.statement: Raise the price of product 4 by 100 and return the id and the new price: UPDATE … RETURNING id, price.

tasks.title: DELETE RETURNING
tasks.statement: Delete the notes where done = 0 and return their id and body (DELETE … RETURNING).

tasks.title: Transaction: transfer
tasks.statement: Transfer 300 rubles from account 1 to account 2 in one transaction: BEGIN; two UPDATEs; COMMIT.
tasks.hint: BEGIN … COMMIT makes two changes one whole.

tasks.title: Rollback
tasks.statement: Start a transaction, take all the money off account 1 (balance = 0) and change your mind: ROLLBACK. After that, credit account 3 a bonus of 10 (an ordinary UPDATE outside a transaction). Account 1 must not change.

tasks.title: Savepoint
tasks.statement: BEGIN; debit 100 from account 1; SAVEPOINT s; debit 100 from account 2; ROLLBACK TO s; COMMIT. Only the first transfer must remain.

tasks.title: Insert without duplicates
tasks.statement: Add two customers: `'Anna Petrova'` (city `'Moscow'`, registered `'2024-01-15'`) and `'Roman Kim'` (city `'Omsk'`, registered `'2024-08-03'`) — each only if no customer with that name exists yet (INSERT … SELECT … WHERE NOT EXISTS). Anna already exists, so only Roman will be added.

tasks.title: Generating rows
tasks.statement: Add three notes to notes with one INSERT … SELECT … UNION ALL: id 10 `'a'`, id 11 `'b'`, id 12 `'c'` (done by default).

tasks.title: HR: raise
tasks.statement: HR database. Raise the salary of all `'junior'` level employees by 10%: salary = salary * 11 / 10.

tasks.title: HR: transfer to a department
tasks.statement: HR database. Transfer employee 14 (`Timur Rahimov`) to department 1 and make him a subordinate of employee 1.

tasks.title: HR: fire
tasks.statement: HR database. Delete the employees hired before 2018 (hired < `'2018-01-01'`).

tasks.title: HR: new department
tasks.statement: HR database. Add department id 6 `'Analytics'` (city `'Moscow'`) and employee id 16 `'Daria Kim'` (department 6, no manager, salary 140000, hired `'2024-08-01'`, email `'daria@corp.ru'`, no phone, grade `'middle'`).

tasks.title: School: grade
tasks.statement: School database. Give the grade 4 to all 2024 enrollments with an empty grade (score IS NULL).

tasks.title: School: new enrollment
tasks.statement: School database. Enroll student 10 in course 3 in 2024 without a grade (score NULL).

tasks.title: Movies: rating
tasks.statement: Movies database. Set the rating 6.5 and the budget 10 for the movie `'Unknown film'`.
